app.name: FordCast
map.title: Every crossing has a story.
map.body: Explore low-water crossings around Austin. Check the evidence before you travel.
map.coverage_body: These public inventory locations have not yet been linked to verified forecast models. Their status is Unknown.
map.preview_body: This browser overview shows real coordinates. The Android development build uses the street map.
map.failed: Map details unavailable. Use the crossing list below.
map.attribution: City of Austin · Travis County Public Works
state.avoid_spoken: Avoid. Flooding likely soon. Take another route.
state.closed_spoken: Flooded. Closed. Never drive into water.
state.unknown_body: No verified upstream forecast is available for this crossing. Follow official warnings and posted barricades.
state.now: Water may already be on the road
crossing.title: Crossing detail
replay.title: See the water rise.
replay.body: Explore the real gauge record from the Halloween 2013 flood on Onion Creek.
replay.caption: USGS archived gauge height · feet
replay.caveat: An observation playback, not a forecast backtest. Archived values may include later corrections. Data gaps are left visible.
replay.pending_body: No lead-time or accuracy result is available yet. Those results require verified crossing thresholds and testing on storms excluded from training.
replay.archive: USGS Water Data OGC API v1
replay.chart_label: Historical gauge-height chart. Use previous and next reading buttons, or show readings for the text table.
drive.title: Plan with caution.
drive.body: Routing and spoken crossing alerts are not available in this prototype. Review saved crossings and official conditions before starting your drive.
alerts.title: Your crossings.
alerts.body: Saved on this device. Saving does not enable push notifications.
alerts.empty_body: Save a crossing from its detail screen to find it here. Remote alerts are not connected yet.
settings.title: Make it yours.
settings.about_body: Agent-authored implementation for FordCast. Real source locations and historical observations are available. Live forecasts, routing and push alerts are not deployed.
settings.privacy_body: Saved crossing IDs, language and your pledge are stored on this device. This prototype does not request your location or register for remote notifications.
settings.sources_body: Inventory: City of Austin Open Data and Travis County Public Works. Gauge locations: USGS NLDI. Historical readings: USGS Water Data. Android map: OpenFreeMap, OpenMapTiles and OpenStreetMap contributors.
onboarding.pledge.title: Before you start
onboarding.pledge.item1: I will never drive into water.
onboarding.pledge.item2: I will obey barricades and official warnings.
onboarding.pledge.item3: FordCast is a student-built forecast. It can be wrong or late, and it never tells me a road is safe.
onboarding.pledge.hint: Check all three statements to continue
onboarding.prototype: Development prototype. No live forecast or driving alerts are connected yet.
legend.title: Read the signs.
legend.body: Shape, symbol and words carry the meaning together.
legend.no_rise: No upstream rise detected; road conditions are not confirmed.
legend.watch: Water is rising upstream. Flooding is possible.
legend.avoid: Flooding is likely soon. Take another route.
legend.closed: Water at the road or a reported official closure.
disclaimer: FordCast is a supplementary tool. Obey barricades and official warnings. Never drive into water.
error.storage: Device storage is unavailable. Preferences will last only for this session.
